observations: Photo 0 shows a used inline four-cylinder petrol car engine out of a vehicle, standing on a workshop floor with other engines behind it.
Black plastic valve cover with four coil-on-plug ignition coils, plastic intake manifold, alternator and belt pulley visible at the bottom.
Green spray paint marks over the valve cover and manifold, typical of imported used engines marked at a yard.
A faint watermark runs across the middle of the photo; it is not legible as a brand or model.
No engine code, maker logo, plate or VIN stamp can be read anywhere in photo 0. The oil filler cap text is not legible.
Wiring harness and sensors appear attached; no damage is visible from this single top angle.
Only one photo: no view of the block stamp, the underside, the sump, the ports or the engine running.

identity.kind: used 4-cylinder petrol car engine (seller says Korean, maker and engine code not readable)
read_from: photo 0 shows a 4-cylinder engine but no readable maker or engine code

claims.claim: Korean parts (implying a Hyundai or Kia engine)
claims.evidence: No maker logo or engine code is legible in photo 0; the layout fits many makers.
Origin and import status cannot be shown by a photo of the engine.

risks.risk: Engine code and displacement unknown; this sets which engine it is and what it is worth.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code stamped on the block (and the sticker or plate on the valve cover or timing cover).
risks.if_unproven: not priceable; identity must be read first

risks.risk: Engine may not run, have low compression, knocking, or a damaged block or head.
risks.proof: Clip of the engine running on a test stand from cold start, with sound, plus a compression test reading on each cylinder.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-running core engine for parts

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ancillaries (alternator, starter, injectors, sensors, harness) on the sides and underside not shown.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides and the underside of the engine, including sump and starter side.
risks.if_unproven: as a long block with ancillaries not included

risks.risk: Cracked block, oil sludge or water in oil.
risks.proof: Photo of the dipstick and under the oil filler cap, and of the sump and block sides.
risks.if_unproven: as a core with internal damage

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code stamped on the block, readable
Clip of the engine running, cold start with sound
Photos of all sides and underside of the engine
Photo of oil on the dipstick and under the filler cap
State what is included: alternator, starter, harness, ECU, gearbox or not
response.reason: This is a used four-cylinder car engine, but no maker or engine code can be read in the only photo, and the engine code is what sets the price, so not even a worst case price can be retrieved. A readable block stamp is needed first.
